scripts.dev: npm run build -w @sffl/shared && concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm:dev:frontend" "npm:dev:backend" "npm:dev:worker"
scripts.start: concurrently -k -n web,api,worker -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run start -w @sffl/frontend" "npm run start -w @sffl/backend" "npm run start:worker -w @sffl/backend"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @sffl/shared && npm run build -w @sffl/frontend && npm run build -w @sffl/backend
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w @sffl/shared && npm run lint -w @sffl/frontend && npm run lint -w @sffl/backend
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @sffl/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sffl/shared && npm run typecheck -w @sffl/frontend && npm run typecheck -w @sffl/backend
scripts.test: npm run test -w @sffl/shared && npm run test -w @sffl/frontend && npm run test -w @sffl/backend
